svg.title: mRNA Transcript
svg.desc: Typical capped and polyadenylated eukaryotic mRNA: a cap, 5-prime UTR, one continuous coding region, 3-prime UTR and connected poly(A) tail. Region lengths and nucleotide marks are schematic, not an exon map or sequence.
